ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: nemu lets you choose images from your photo library when updating manga covers.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: nemu uses the microphone when you dictate a message to Nemu chat.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: nemu uses speech recognition to turn what you say into text for Nemu chat.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: nemu connects to a server on your local network only when you enter its address in a source's settings, such as a LANraragi server.
